About
I’m a PhD researcher at Ulster University, where I also lecture part-time. My research looks at how networks of resource-constrained devices can train machine learning models together without sharing raw data, and how to decide which devices should work together and which to trust. My PhD is supervised by Prof. Chris Nugent, Prof. Jun Liu, anDr Ian Clelend
Before moving into AI research, I worked in industry as a hardware and software engineer at Schrader Electronics and Sensata Technologies. That background shapes my focus on systems that work on real, constrained hardware.
